sourceRecords.title: 16 · Common room · area 10
read: Dice clatter across a scarred table. Four red-cloaked figures sit around a game, cups and coins at their elbows.

The tables and scattered possessions make this a room people spend time in, not simply a passage to somewhere else. You can take in the faces and the gaps between the furniture before answering. Whether you listen, bluff, or confront them, their reactions are something you can actually observe.

brief: Large stone common room with several worn tables and chairs, wooden benches against walls hung with brown and red draperies, tapped ale kegs. FOUR rough-looking human warriors wearing scarlet cloaks drink and play knucklebones around ONE table; small heap of ordinary coins and trinkets on its surface. Relaxed unruly moment before interruption, not combat. Bright oil lamps; no skull throne, tavern crowd or extra guards.
